Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following Body Length field up to and including the delimiter preceding the Check Sum field. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be third field in message. 0 = Heartbeat 1 = Test Request 2 = Resend Request 3 = Reject 4 = Sequence Reset 5 = Logout 8 = Execution Report 9 = Order Cancel Reject A = Logon D = New Order Single F = Order Cancel Request G = Order Cancel Replace Request AE = Trade Capture Report AR = Trade Capture Report Ack UCC = Trade Cancel/Correct

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Comp ID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Sub ID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination: ‘CXA’ for messages sent to CXA Exchange. (Sender Comp ID for messages from Cboe)
Check Sum Check Sum Modulo 256 Check Sum of all characters in message up to and

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: ‘N’ (default) indicates a new order. ‘Y’ indicates an application level resend and is not supported. The message will be logged, but effectively ignored. For reasons of economy, Cboe does not track (in primary storage) the Cl Ord ID values of orders that are no longer live. For reasons of performance, Cboe does not access secondary storage to enforce unique Cl Ord ID values against orders that are no longer live. Without full duplicate Cl Ord ID value enforcement, it is not possible to safely implement the full behavior specified in the FIX 4.2 Protocol for Poss Resend (97) =‘Y’.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Used by a trading participant or a broker service provider to provide a broker cross reference. Reflected back on Execution Reports associated with this order.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. The ‘at’ symbol and double quotes are also not allowed. If the Cl Ord Id matches a live order it will be rejected as duplicate (unless Poss Resend (97) =‘Y’, see above). Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of Cl Ord ID values among currently live orders. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your Cl Ord ID values day unique.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Single value only (with no trailing space) For more details on each order type, see the following sections: Peg Orders, Best X Orders, and Market X Orders. All values not defined below are ignored. P = Market Peg (peg Buy [Sell] to NBBO Offer [Bid], one tick within NBBO) R = Primary Peg (peg Buy [Sell] to NBBO Bid [Offer], one tick within NBBO) M = Midpoint (peg to NBBO Midpoint) Max Floor (111) must be 0 if • Exec Inst (18) is M, P, or R and • Time In Force (59) is 0 or 6. j = Best X Order (insert the limit order at the best visible price on same side). Not supported if Time In Force (59) is 3 or 4. k = Market X Order (insert the limit order against the best visible price on opposite side).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for order, 1 to 999,999,999.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 2 = Limit 5 = Market On Close (MOC) P = Pegged MOC requires Max Floor = 0 if Time In Force(59) is 0 or 6.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit Price. If Ord Type(40) is • 2 (Limit) – Required Limit Price unless Exec Inst (18) is j (Best X) or k (Market X). Optional cap price for Best X and Market X orders. Rejected if price is finer than the minimum trading increment for the stock. • P (Pegged) – Required Cap Price. Rejected if price is finer than ½ the minimum trading increment for the stock. • 5 (MOC) – Order will be rejected if Price is specified.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: The capacity for the order. A = Agency P = Principal X = Mixed

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell Short (client affirms ability to borrow)

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (upper case alphanumeric).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = DAY (default) 1 = GTC (Good Till Cancel) 3 = IOC (portion not filled immediately is cancelled). 4 = FOK (an IOC where the entire size must be filled, else the order will be cancelled back). 6 = GTD. Expires at the specified: • Expire Time or end of day, or • Expire Date for Multi-Day orders.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time order initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2, but not used by Cboe.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum fill quantity is accepted only on the following order types (otherwise the order will be rejected): • Orders having Time In Force(59) = 3 (IOC), or

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Portion of Order Qty to display. Used for iceberg orders and hidden orders. Iceberg orders are Limit orders (40=2) and require Max Floor > 0 if specified. For iceberg orders, this is the displayed quantity. The balance is reserve. The displayed quantity of each order at a price level is decremented first. Hidden orders are Pegged orders (40=P) and MOC orders (40=5). A hidden order must use Max Floor =0, which hides the entire quantity. Ignored if order is IOC.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Only applicable for Time In Force (59) = ‘6’ (GTD) orders, specifies the UTC Date/Time timestamp when the order expires. GTD orders with Expire Time will expire at the earlier of the end of the current trading day and the Expire Time. Required if Time In Force is 6 (GTD) and Expire Date is not specified.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Only applicable for Time In Force (59) = ‘6’ (GTD) orders, specifies the date in “YYYYMMDD” format when the order expires. GTD orders with Expire Date will expire at the earlier of the GTC Date Refresh and the end of Expire Date. Required if Time In Force is 6 (GTD) and Expire Time is not specified. Ignored if Time In Force is not 6 (GTD) or if Expire Time is present.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CHESS Clearing Participant ID. Must be a valid 5 digit CHESS PID.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Supplemental identifier. 10 character alphanumeric. Spaces, symbols, or special characters are not allowed.

Field.Name: Undisclosed
Field.Description: Indicates an undisclosed order. Possible values: ‘Y’ or ‘N’ (Default = ‘N’).

Field.Name: ClientCrossRef
Field.Description: Can be used to provide additional client side cross reference information. Up to 15 printable characters (ASCII range 32-126).

Field.Name: ShortSellNakedQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of Order Qty (38) that is naked. It is assumed zero if it is not specified with a short sell order. Ignored unless Side (54) = 5.

Field.Name: ShortSellCoveredQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of Order Qty (38) that is covered. It is assumed zero if it is not specified with a short sell order. Ignored unless Side (54) = 5.

Field.Name: ShortSellLongQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of Order Qty (38) owned by the participant who placed the order. It is assumed zero if it is not specified with a short sell order. Ignored unless Side (54) = 5. Order having Side (54) = 5 (sell short) will be rejected unless Short Sell Naked Qty + Short Sell Covered Qty + Short Sell Long Qty is equal to the Order Qty (38) and Short Sell Long Qty < Order Qty (38).

Field.Name: RiskGroupID
Field.Description: Optional participant-specified ID for the order. Integer 1-65535.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: Interactions of orders from the same participant (defined by reference to the first 3 digits of the trading PID) with the same No Trade Key (7714) value will be managed by the newer order’s No Trade Feat (7713) instruction. Ignored if No Trade Feat (7713)=U. Up to 10 printable ASCII characters (in the inclusive range 32..126).

Field.Name: MEQSE
Field.Description: Possible values: Y = Minimum Execution Quantity Single Execution (MEQSE) N = Minimum Execution Quantity (MEQ) Default is ‘N’. MEQSE is only supported on the following order types that have Min Qty(110) specified (otherwise the order will be rejected): • MOC or Pegged Orders (Ord Type(40) = 5 or P) with any Time In Force(59). If after a partial fill the remaining size (Leaves Qty) on an order is less than the defined Min Qty, then Min Qty is set to the Leaves Qty. If traded, the MEQSE size will be satisfied by a single fill.

Field.Name: IntermediaryID
Field.Description: N Market Integrity Rule defined field for Intermediary Identifier–may be populated with AFS license number. Up to 10 characters in ASCII range 32-126 are allowed.

Field.Name: DirectedWholesaleIndic
Field.Description: N Market Integrity Rule defined field to identify wholesale client. Possible values: ‘Y’ or ‘N’ (default ‘N’).

Field.Name: RemoveCrossingFromCl earing
Field.Description: N Instructs Cboe on how to process crossed trades with CHESS. Please contact Cboe Australia to confirm settings. Possible values: ‘Y’ or ‘N’ (default ‘N’).

Field.Name: BrokerPreferencing
Field.Description: N Y = Use broker preferencing N = No broker preferencing Defaults to port setting. Rejects if Broker Preferencing=Y and Ord Type(40)=2 (Limit) and Time In Force(59)=0 or 6 (DAY or GTD).

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: N P = Post Only (never take liquidity) where Ord Type(40)=2 (Limit order) and Time In Force(59)= 0 (DAY) or 1 (GTC) or 6 (GTD). F = Focused Nearpoint (only eligible to trade with opposing Farpoint) where Ord Type(40)=P (Pegged order) and Exec Inst(18)=R (Primary/Nearpoint). Defaults to port setting.

Field.Name: DisplayIndicator
Field.Description: N Treatment of Post Only orders on entry if creating a locked NBBO. All Post Only orders on entry which would create a crossed NBBO are cancelled back. V = Default. Post Only orders which would lock the NBBO on entry are allowed to do so. R = Cancel back the Post Only order on entry if it were to create a locked NBBO. Defaults to port setting.

Field.Description: ‘N’ (default) indicates a new cancel. ‘Y’ Indicates an application level unsolicited resend. If Cl Ord ID has not yet been seen, the cancel is treated as normal. If Cl Ord ID already exists, the resent cancel is ignored.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Present for acknowledgements and fills (150=0, 150=1 or 150=2). Recommended mapping to FIX Tag 851 provided: 1st Character A = Trade Added Liquidity (851=1) R = Trade Removed Liquidity (851=2) C = Auction / Uncrossing (851=4) Added or Executed during an auction period. 2nd Character I = Added Hidden Liquidity that was price improved J = Added Liquidity NBBO Joiner K = Added Liquidity from the hidden (reserve) portion of an iceberg order S = Added Liquidity NBBO Setter O = Opening Auction or intra-day auction C = Closing Auction A = Halt Auction (Re-Opening) Match Trade Prevention (MTP) For participants that opt-in to Report MTP Fields functionality (at firm or port level), the liquidity add and remove values may be presented on an MTP triggered cancel/restatement. For Auction Trades (1st character = C), the 2nd character will be populated as follows: • “O” Opening auction applies to standard 10:00 open, plus first day of trading auction for a new symbol • “C” Closing auction applies to standard 16:13 end of trading auction
